properties.name: v-model
properties.description: Binding data with v-model

properties.name: placeholder
properties.description: The string to display when the text field is empty.

properties.name: shape
properties.description: The shape. You must enter one of three types: border, underline, none

properties.name: type
properties.description: The type. You must enter one of three types: none, password, searchable

properties.name: clearable
properties.description: Whether to use the text field initialization function(with icon).

properties.name: disabled
properties.description: Switch to inactive state.

properties.name: readonly
properties.description: Switch to read-only state.

properties.name: size
properties.description: The size You must enter one of three types: large, medium, small.

properties.name: counter
properties.description: Specifies the maximum length value of the string to be entered.

properties.name: width
properties.description: Set width of text-field You can choose unit in PX and % If you skip the unit(just number) in value, we consider that unit is PX

properties.name: mask
properties.description: Mask expression. Expressed as a combination of # (number), A (uppercase), a (lowercase), N (number / uppercase), n (number / lowercase), and special symbols.

properties.name: autocomplete
properties.description: You can specify a form input field to allow auto completion, and you can guide the user agent information which you want to auto completion.

properties.name: maxlength
properties.description: define Max Length on Textfield

properties.name: messageStyle
properties.description: Guide, Success, Announcement appearance attributes. You can specify the 'heavy' and 'light' attributes.

properties.name: guideMessage
properties.description: The string to display as the guide message.

properties.name: successMessage
properties.description: The message that is output if validate passes. If there is no setting, guide message or no message is printed. ur-dropdown does not occupy space for message output. Depending on the messageStyle prop, you can apply two style: light and heavy. If you want to print the message, you need to make space.

properties.name: rules
properties.description: Rule-set for using validator. Specified by an Array type, each element returns a boolean true on successful validation and a validate failure error message.

properties.name: lazy
properties.description: Components that use ur-validator-mixin call validateOnEvent() based on component properties. If lazy is set to true, validate() will not execute when validateOnEvent() is called.

properties.name: noShake
properties.description: Determines whether shake animation should be applied to the component when it fails.

properties.name: fixedMessage
properties.description: Show message fixed style.

properties.name: tabindex
properties.description: Set tabindex.

events.name: click-icon
events.description: Event fires when click icon in text-field.

events.name: enter
events.description: Event fires when pressing the Enter key.

events.name: input
events.description: When the input value is changed, an event is triggered with the changed value as a parameter.
